concerns.text: Task T014b enforces a 'hard constraint of [deferred] iterations'. This violates FR-001 and Constitution Principle VI which mandate 'at least 10,000 iterations'. A task cannot satisfy an FR by deferring the core quantitative requirement; the iteration count must be concretized (e.g., N=10000) in the task description to satisfy the spec.

Task T016 (Write output results to p_values_raw.csv) is marked unchecked. FR-002 and US-1 Acceptance Scenario 1 explicitly require the system to 'output a CSV containing the raw p-values'. Leaving this task incomplete means the deliverable for FR-002 is missing, violating the requirement that the task list must cover all FR deliverables.

Task T018 (Save aggregated error rates) is marked unchecked. FR-002 requires calculating and storing empirical error rates. Without this task being defined as complete, the core metric of the simulation (error rates) is not produced, failing the FR-002 deliverable.

Task T031 (Run tests on real datasets) is unchecked. FR-006 mandates validation against 3 specific public datasets. If this task is not implemented, the FR-006 requirement is unmet. The task list must reflect the completion of all FR-mandated validation steps.

Task T032 (Bootstrapped power estimation & KS distance) is unchecked. SC-003 requires measuring consistency via KS distance (<= 0.10). T032 is the only task addressing this success criterion. Its unchecked status implies the SC-003 validation is not being performed, violating the success criteria.

Task T034 (Save validation metrics) is unchecked. FR-006 requires reporting validation results. Without saving the metrics, the validation is not recorded, failing the 'Single Source of Truth' principle (Constitution IV) and FR-006.

Task T036 (Optimize for memory < 7GB) is unchecked. The Assumptions section and Plan.md explicitly state the constraint: 'memory < 7 GB'. If this optimization task is not completed, the system risks violating the hard compute constraint defined in the plan and spec assumptions.

Task T040 attempts to 'Define the exact iteration count... replacing [deferred]'. This confirms the previous tasks (T014b) were semantically weakened by leaving the count as [deferred]. The task list currently contains a 'fix' task for a requirement that should have been satisfied in the initial task definition (FR-001).
